text.en: Gain 1 seed from the birdfeeder (if available). You may cache it on this card.
text.zh: 从喂食器获得 1 份种子（如果有的话）。你可以将它储存在这张鸟类卡上。

text.en: When another player takes the "lay eggs" action, this bird lays 1 egg on another bird with a ground nest.
text.zh: 当另一位玩家执行 “产下鸟蛋” 行动时，这只鸟在另一只拥有地面巢的鸟上产下 1 个鸟蛋。

text.en: Player(s) with the fewest wetland birds: draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 湿地鸟类最少的玩家（们）：抽取 1 张鸟类卡。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再抽1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Discard 1 egg from any of your other birds to gain 1 wild from the supply.
text.zh: 从你的任意其他鸟类卡上弃除 1 个鸟蛋来从供应堆获得 1 个任意食物。

text.en: Gain 3 seed from the supply.
text.zh: 从供应堆获得3粒种子。

text.en: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are rodent, gain 1 rodent and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 投掷所有不在喂食器中的骰子。如果有啮齿动物，获取 1 份啮齿动物并储存在这张卡上。

text.en: Draw bird card equal to the number of players +1. Starting with you and proceeding clockwise, each player selects 1 of those cards and places it in their hand. You keep the extra card.
text.zh: 抽取玩家数量 +1 的鸟类卡。从你开始顺时针继续，每位玩家从中选取 1 张加入手牌。你保留多出来的那张。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再抽1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Discard a fish to tuck 2 bird card from the deck behind this bird.
text.zh: 弃除一条鱼来将牌库顶的2张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。

text.en: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are fish, gain 1 fish and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 投掷所有不在喂食器中的骰子。如果有鱼，获取 1 份鱼并储存在这张卡上。

text.en: Each player gains 1 food from the birdfeeder, starting with the player of your choice.

text.en: Lay 1 egg on each of your birds with a cavity nest.
text.zh: 在你每个拥有树洞巢的鸟上产下 1 个鸟蛋。

text.en: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
text.zh: 抽取2张新的奖励卡并保留1张。

text.zh: 在任意一张鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。

text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这只鸟下方。如果你这么做了，再从供应堆获得 1 只无脊椎动物或 1 粒种子。

text.en: All players gain 1 seed from the supply.
text.zh: 所有玩家从供应堆获得1粒种子。

text.en: Gain 1 seed from the birdfeeder (if available). You may cache it on this card.
text.zh: 从喂食器获得 1 份种子（如果有的话）。你可以将它储存在这张鸟类卡上。

text.en: Gain 1 seed from the supply and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 从供应堆获得 1 份种子并储存在这张鸟类卡上。

text.en: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
text.zh: 抽取2张新的奖励卡并保留1张。

text.en: Play a second bird in your forest. Pay its normal cost.
text.zh: 在你的森林中打出第二只鸟。照常支付费用。

text.en: Gain 1 seed from the birdfeeder (if available). You may cache it on this card.
text.zh: 从喂食器获得 1 份种子（如果有的话）。你可以将它储存在这张鸟类卡上。

text.en: Look at a bird card from the deck. If <75cm, tuck it behind this bird. If not, discard it.
text.zh: 查看牌库顶的1张鸟类卡，如果<75cm，将其塞到这只猛禽的下方。如果不是，将其弃掉。

text.en: Look at a bird card from the deck. If <75cm, tuck it behind this bird. If not, discard it.
text.zh: 查看牌库顶的1张鸟类卡，如果<75cm，将其塞到这只猛禽的下方。如果不是，将其弃掉。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, also lay 1 egg on this bird.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再在这张鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再抽1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Gain 1 seed or fruit from the birdfeeder, if there is one.
text.zh: 从喂食器获取 1 份种子或水果，如果有的话。

text.en: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
text.zh: 抽取2张新的奖励卡并保留1张。

text.en: Play a second bird in your forest. Pay its normal cost.
text.zh: 在你的森林中打出第二只鸟。照常支付费用。

text.en: Each player gains 1 food from the birdfeeder, starting with the player of your choice.
text.zh: 每位玩家从喂食器获取 1 份食物，从你选择的玩家开始。

text.en: Draw 2 bird card. If you do, discard 1 bird card from your hand at the end of your turn.
text.zh: 抽取 2 张鸟类卡。如果你这样做，在回合结束时从你手中丢弃 1 张鸟类卡。

text.en: Discard 1 seed to tuck 2 bird card from the deck behind this bird.
text.zh: 弃除一个种子来将牌库顶的2张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。

text.en: Play a second bird in your grassland. Pay its normal cost.
text.zh: 在你的草原打出第二只鸟。照常支付费用。

text.en: Lay 1 egg on each of your birds with a bowl nest.
text.zh: 在你每个拥有碗状巢的鸟上产下 1 个鸟蛋。

text.en: All players gain 1 invertebrate from the supply.
text.zh: 所有玩家从供应堆获得 1 份无脊椎动物。

text.en: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are fish, gain 1 fish and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 投掷所有不在喂食器中的骰子。如果有鱼，获取 1 份鱼并储存在这张卡上。

text.en: If this bird is to the right of all other birds in its habitat, move it to another habitat.
text.zh: 如果这只鸟在所处栖息地所有其他鸟的右边，将它移动到另一个栖息地。

text.en: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
text.zh: 抽取2张新的奖励卡并保留1张。

text.en: All players draw 1 bird card from the deck.
text.zh: 所有玩家从牌库顶抓1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Gain 1 seed from the supply.
text.zh: 从供应堆获得1粒种子。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再抽1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Play a second bird in your forest. Pay its normal cost.
text.zh: 在你的森林中打出第二只鸟。照常支付费用。

text.en: When another player's predator succeeds, gain 1 food from the birdfeeder.
text.zh: 当另一位玩家捕猎成功时，从喂食器获取 1 份食物。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再抽1张鸟类卡。

text.en: All players lay 1 egg on any 1 ground bird. You may lay 1 egg on 1 additional ground bird.
text.zh: 所有玩家在任意一张带有地面巢的鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。你可以额外在另1张带有地面巢的鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。

text.en: Gain 1 invertebrate or fruit from the birdfeeder, if there is one.
text.zh: 从喂食器中获取 1 份无脊椎动物或水果，如果有的话。

text.en: Gain 1 seed from the supply and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 从供应堆获得 1 份种子并储存在这张鸟类卡上。

text.en: If this bird is to the right of all other birds in its habitat, move it to another habitat.
text.zh: 如果这只鸟在所处栖息地所有其他鸟的右边，将它移动到另一个栖息地。

text.en: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are fish, gain 1 fish and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 投掷所有不在喂食器中的骰子。如果有鱼，获取 1 份鱼并储存在这张卡上。

text.en: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
text.zh: 抽取2张新的奖励卡并保留1张。

text.en: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are fish, gain 1 fish and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 投掷所有不在喂食器中的骰子。如果有鱼，获取 1 份鱼并储存在这张卡上。

text.en: All players draw 1 bird card from the deck.
text.zh: 所有玩家从牌库顶抓1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Draw 2 bird card. If you do, discard 1 bird card from your hand at the end of your turn.
text.zh: 抽取 2 张鸟类卡。如果你这样做，在回合结束时从你手中丢弃 1 张鸟类卡。

text.en: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
text.zh: 抽取2张新的奖励卡并保留1张。

text.en: Gain 1 invertebrate from the supply.
text.zh: 从供应堆获得 1 份无脊椎动物。

text.en: When another player takes the "lay eggs" action, this bird lays 1 egg on another bird with a bowl nest.
text.zh: 当另一位玩家执行 “产下鸟蛋” 行动时，这只鸟在另一只拥有碗状巢的鸟上产下 1 个鸟蛋。

text.en: If this bird is to the right of all other birds in its habitat, move it to another habitat.
text.zh: 如果这只鸟在所处栖息地所有其他鸟的右边，将它移动到另一个栖息地。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, also lay 1 egg on this bird.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再在这张鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 bird card.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再抽1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Gain 1 wild from the birdfeeder.
text.zh: 从喂食器获取 1 份任意食物。

text.en: All players gain a fruit from the supply.
text.zh: 所有玩家从供应堆获得1个水果。

text.en: Draw the 3 face-up bird card in the bird tray.
text.zh: 抽取托盘中 3 张面朝上的鸟类卡。

text.en: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are a rodent, gain 1 rodent and cache it on this card.
text.zh: 投掷所有不在喂食器中的骰子。如果有啮齿动物，获取 1 份啮齿动物并储存在这张卡上。

text.en: All players draw 1 bird card from the deck.
text.zh: 所有玩家从牌库顶抓1张鸟类卡。

text.en: Gain 1 invertebrate from the supply.
text.zh: 从供应堆获得 1 份无脊椎动物。

text.en: Draw 2 bird card. If you do, discard 1 bird card from your hand at the end of your turn.
text.zh: 抽取 2 张鸟类卡。如果你这样做，在回合结束时从你手中丢弃 1 张鸟类卡。

text.zh: 在这张鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。

text.en: Tuck a bird card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, lay 1 egg on any bird.
text.zh: 从你手中将一张鸟类卡塞到这张鸟类卡的下方。如果你这么做了，再在任意一张鸟类卡上产下1个鸟蛋。
